title: Returned Payments and the Charged-Off Settlement Plan Term
content:
**Rule.** For a Charged-Off Settlement Plan of the Hardship Assistance Programs, a loan with a payment returned in the six calendar months before the term is recorded and no payment posted after the latest return loses 2 installments; a loan with a payment returned in those six months and a payment posted after the latest return loses 1 installment; any other loan loses none. A payment posted on the same day as the latest return does not count as posted after it, and a ledger row counts as inside those six months when fewer than six whole calendar months separate its date from the day the term is recorded, a row dated exactly six months before it falling outside them. Returns and payments are read from the loan's Personal Loans payment ledger.

## Points of judgement

| Ledger of the loan | Installments lost |
|---|---|
| a return within the six months, no payment posted after the latest return | 2 |
| a return within the six months, a payment posted after the latest return | 1 |
| no return within the six months | none |

- A payment posted on the same day as the latest return is not "after" it: with nothing posted later, the loan loses 2.
- Hypothetical edge, term recorded on 15 August: a return dated 16 February is inside the six months; a return dated 15 February is exactly six months back and outside.
